subject: Renewal + Expansion: Tessera action plan & QBR windows
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Clara Ng <clara.ng@tessera.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + Expansion: Tessera action plan & QBR windows

Hi Clara —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. We kicked off an internal sync to align on the renewal + expansion runway. Attached is a starter action plan (Tessera_MA_action_plan_v1.xlsx) — high level notes below and a couple of concrete asks to keep momentum: 

Summary: Tessera is up for renewal in late July and is targeting a staged capacity uplift (approx +45% peak tokens, +2x concurrency) across two product lines (Ingest and S2 Embeddings). We want to ensure throughput and cost projections are validated before the QBR.

Proposed timeline (short view):
- Week of May 12: Finalize stakeholder roster + baseline usage extract (Ben)
- Week of May 19: Cost/throughput delta and recommended configuration (Irene + runtime)
- Week of May 26: Internal tech dry run and QBR agenda drafted (Mateo)
- Week of June 2–6: Customer QBR (preferred window) — 60–75 minutes
- Mid-July: DocuSign for amended term (if agreed)

Current asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm the list of internal Tessera stakeholders who should attend the QBR and procurement contact (for term/legal)? I noted Jordan Patel as procurement — correct?
2) Please confirm your preferred QBR week from June 2–6 or provide alternative weeks in late May.
3) Can you attach the latest 30-day peak+avg usage export (or grant read access to the usage dashboard) so we can produce the "expected_usage_delta.csv"?

Attachments: Tessera_MA_action_plan_v1.xlsx (action items + ownership), expected_usage_delta.csv (placeholder — we'll populate when we get usage), Tessera_QBR_agenda.docx (draft agenda)

I'll book tentative calendar blocks for June 3–4 pending your availability. If you'd prefer a shorter readout, we can compress to a 45-minute session focused on SLA and capacity scoping.

Best —
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0121

Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform
From: Clara Ng <clara.ng@tessera.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@tessera.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + Expansion: Tessera action plan & QBR windows

Thanks Mateo — appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers:

- Stakeholders: Clara Ng (data platform lead), Jordan Patel (procurement), Amira Solano (Head of Product, product@tessera.ai), Mark Liu (SRE lead, mark.liu@tessera.ai). Please include Amira and Mark in the technical run.
- Preferred QBR week: June 2–6 works best; primary preference is June 4 (afternoon PT).
- Usage extract: I'll share a 30-day export this afternoon (Jordan will route the procurement contact details separately).

Two clarifying items from our side:
1) The +45% peak estimate — is that for sustained peak or expected burst? We plan to smooth some workloads by batching but want to understand pricing implications.
2) Can Redwood provide a short note on fallback behavior if we exceed committed capacity during peak events? We have a hard availability constraint for the ingestion pipeline.

Jordan: adding you for procurement coordination.

Thanks,
Clara
Clara Ng
Data Platform Lead, Tessera AI
clara.ng@tessera.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Clara Ng <clara.ng@tessera.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + Expansion: Tessera action plan & QBR windows

Great — tagging this for internal owners. Action items I picked up: 

- Ben: pull last 90-day usage and build the expected_usage_delta.csv with a conservative +45% uplift projection and a burst scenario (+80% for up to 2 hours). Deliver by May 16.
- Irene (runtime): validate latency SLOs under the uplift and recommend instance sizing + quantization profile; include cost delta per 1M tokens.
- Mateo: draft QBR agenda with timeboxes (30 min tech, 20 min commercial, 15 min next steps).

Irene — can you also compile any security/compliance pre-reads that Tessera might ask for (SOC2 sub-scope, relevant retention windows, and audit log exports)? If anything needs redaction, flag early.

Irene Choi
Platform Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Clara Ng <clara.ng@tessera.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + Expansion: Tessera action plan & QBR windows

On Mon, May 12, 2025 at 01:02 PM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Great — tagging this for internal owners. Action items I picked up: 

Thanks Ben — I'll start with a focused runbook for the June 4 tech dry run. Preliminary notes below: 

- Capacity config: recommend dedicated pool with mixed instance types (A100 + H100 fallback) for Ingest, plus ephemeral autoscale for embeddings to meet concurrency demands.
- Cost tradeoffs: quantize embeddings model to int8 for cost savings (~20% lower per-token) while keeping Ingest on fp16 for latency. I'll include bench marks in the deliverable.
- Fallback behavior: automated routing to a compatible fallback model variant (lower-capacity) during sustained oversubscribe, with alerting and optional burst-credit usage to avoid throttling. We'll document the sequence and expected impact in the QBR.

Attachments I'll provide by May 16: latency SLO matrix, instance sizing recommendations, and a short SOC2 evidence index for what Tessera typically requests.

Irene Choi
Platform Solutions Engineer
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Clara Ng <clara.ng@tessera.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@tessera.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + Expansion: Tessera action plan & QBR windows

Perfect — thanks everyone. Quick summary and next steps: 

- QBR scheduled: June 4, 2025, 13:00–14:15 PT (I have a tentative invite out; Clara/Jordan please accept).
- Deliverables due May 16: expected_usage_delta.csv (Ben), latency & sizing + SOC2 index (Irene).
- Procurement path: Jordan, we'll send an initial amendment and DocuSign link the week of June 9 pending QBR alignment.

Linking here to the draft agenda and shared artifacts: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcdExampleDriveLink

If Jordan confirms procurement contact details, I'll route the amendment for review. Clara — appreciate the usage export later today; we'll incorporate and re-run the cost delta.

Thanks — I'll consolidate every deliverable into the shared drive and push the final QBR slide deck by May 29.

Best,
Mateo
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0121
